external_entities.name: Member
external_entities.description: A library member who uses the library app and self-service kiosks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: Desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to modify loan and account records.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: Library app
processes.description: A phone application through which members renew loans and reserve titles, calling the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: Self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk that scans library cards and books and sends loans and returns to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

processes.name: Lending API
processes.description: The REST API that receives lending activity, applies loan rules and reads or writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: Lending service note states: "The lending API is internal-only." Interview transcript states: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." These are incompatible positive claims about exposure, so exposure remains unknown. Priya also says: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." This is a voiced uncertainty, so authentication is not recorded as a value.

data_stores.name: Loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.

data_flows.name: use library app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

data_flows.name: write changes
data_flows.description: The library app requests loan renewals and reservations from the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya says: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." Authentication is unknown because this is hedged.
data_flows.data_description: Book and member identifiers, loan renewals and reservation requests

data_flows.name: send loan returns
data_flows.description: A self-service kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: Library card, books, loans and returns

data_flows.name: change loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page; the password is on a card taped under the desk.
data_flows.data_description: Loan, member account block and return status changes

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and member borrowing history

trust_boundaries.name: Member phone
trust_boundaries.description: The phone on which the library app runs; it is outside library control.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

trust_boundaries.name: Branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network used by branch kiosks and desk staff.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.
trust_boundaries.notes: Desk staff also work on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: Council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full member borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."
